question:
Inventory service DB bakeoff among fictional vendors. Rank for transactional inventory + managed replicas:
KeystoneDB, Rivermouth, LatticeQL, Umber Store, Pinecone Ledger, Harborbase, Cobalt Rows, Glassgraph, Drift Index, WillowKV.

web_snippets.excerpt:
KeystoneDB: low p99, pricey. Rivermouth: friendly support. LatticeQL: SQL-ish, young.
Harborbase: "unspectacular benchmarks, excellent backup story and point-in-time recovery drills."
WillowKV: wrong model for inventory. Glassgraph: graph hype.
Published detailed postmortems; replica promotion tested quarterly. Not the fastest TPS in vendor shootouts.
Pinecone Ledger and Cobalt Rows advertise HTAP. Umber Store: column-y. Drift Index: search/analytics cosplay as OLTP.

scoring_note: No authoritative ranking in evidence. Activation=principal_first; chance~0.10. C0 is the null.
